title: Use assistant '{' JSON prefill in LLMClient suppressLocalThinking for local thinking models
goal: Eliminate thinking-token leakage and speed up local LM Studio JSON calls across thinking models in production LLMClient.

sections.what: Upgrade suppressLocalThinking in static/js/llm-client.ts to use assistant '{' prefill on JSON-object calls so local thinking models emit clean JSON without leaking reasoning outlines into visible content.
sections.why: Live LM Studio testing proved that assistant ' ' prefill causes gemma-4-e4b to dump its reasoning outline into visible content, whereas assistant '{' prefill drops reasoning_content to 0 on both gemma-4-e4b and lfm3-1.7b (cutting lfm3-1.7b latency from 22.6s to 1.26s).
sections.how:
1. In static/js/llm-client.ts, when suppressLocalThinking is true and the call expects a JSON object (responseFormat or json mode), append {role: 'assistant', content: '{'} instead of {role: 'assistant', content: ' '} and prepend '{' back to the completion before returning.
2. Preserve existing behavior for non-JSON / free-text calls.
3. Run npm run typecheck, npm run build:ts, and verify against LM Studio.
sections.verify: Run npm run typecheck, npm run build:ts, and verify clean JSON output on local LM Studio thinking models (gemma-4-e4b, lfm3-1.7b).

acceptance.text: static/js/llm-client.ts supports optional assistant '{' JSON prefill when suppressLocalThinking is enabled on JSON-mode calls, prepending '{' back onto the returned string before JSON parsing.
Tested against local LM Studio thinking models (e.g. gemma-4-e4b, lfm3-1.7b) with zero reasoning-outline leakage into visible content and clean JSON parsing.
npm run typecheck and npm run build:ts pass with 0 errors.

custom.browser_ui: No new UI controls required; uses the existing Suppress Local Thinking toggle in LLM settings. Manual check: enable Suppress Local Thinking with a local thinking model in LM Studio and verify JSON turn responses parse cleanly without reasoning text leaking into content.
